roughness_limitation: Original Gaussian high-pass closure intentionally held for isolated geometry comparison; it is not yet the residual of the actual rendered basis. No full geometry/BRDF partition qualification.
model_limitations: Assumed generic material constants, not measured, calibrated, or experimentally validated for a polymer.
Local independent columns: no lateral momentum, incompressible volume conservation, gas compression/venting, injection filling, or full 3D contact elasticity.
The Maxwell modulus and dashpot describe an effective surface layer; no molecular microstructure or physical phase transition is solved.
Cooling is solved through a 4mm half-thickness with an adiabatic back; skin_fraction is only a diagnostic of temperature below an assumed threshold.
Final retained displacement is the idealized unloaded dashpot state after a 0.5s surface imprint window; this is not a whole-part ejection or mold-cycle prediction.
Mold is an infinite isothermal thermal reservoir.
No thermal contraction, crystallization, shrinkage, residual stress field, macroscopic seams, ejector marks or draft is generated by this core.
Response-table interpolation maps already-solved independent local columns to the native tool; no spatial noise and no fixed replication factor.
